name: Djinn
description: Spirits of air or fire, commonly forced into slavery by mortals to grant wishes, found across many planes and predominantly blue.

timeline.summary: Several djinns join the coalition at the time of the Phyrexian Invasion.
timeline.quote: At the time of the Phyrexian Invasion , several djinns joined the fight on the side of the coalition

citation.text: "Djinn", section "Coalition djinns". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In Tarkir's new timeline, Ojutai and his brood conquer Jeskai lands and many djinn submit to dragon worship; after the Stormnexus Ritual, many leave the Way.
timeline.quote: In the new timeline, Jeskai lands were conquered by the dragonlord Ojutai and his brood, and many djinn submitted to his teachings of dragon worship.

citation.text: "Djinn", section "Tarkir". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Starting with Modern Horizons 3, Efreet is retired as a creature type in favor of Djinn.
timeline.quote: Efreet was retired as a creature type, with Design preference Djinn going forward.

citation.text: "Efreet", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

relations.note: Known for enmity toward the djinn.
relations.quote: King Suleiman was known for his enmity toward the djinn.

citation.text: "Djinn", section "Rabiah". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

pages_say.description: A being who legend says gave the goblins a gift they could never master.
